headlines.title: Macy’s parade postponed over powerful storm
headlines.description: Macy’s officially pressing pause on its iconic Thanksgiving Day Parade, now postponed to Saturday with a powerful storm closing in. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: Thanksgiving Day parade celebrates 100 years
headlines.description: With the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade now happening days after it was scheduled, rain or shine it is marking 100 years with what is planned to be the biggest parade in their history. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

headlines.title: Tons of toxic chemicals detonate in Iowa
headlines.description: Two plumes filled the sky after the Army detonated nearly five tons of bomb-making material. The blast could be felt for miles. There’s no airborne lead detected throughout the region and the EPA says they’ll continue to test the air, soil and water. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster has the story.

headlines.title: Steelers release Aaron Rodgers after he blasts head coach over benching
headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers released quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he blasted head coach Mike McCarthy over being benched. NBC News sports reporter Andrew Greif details Rodgers' accusations.

headlines.title: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses for now
headlines.description: The Walt Disney Co. secured a temporary restraining order Wednesday blocking the Federal Communications Commission from moving forward with an unusually early review of ABC’s broadcast-station licenses, which the media company has called an attack on free speech by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Military families fight for fixes to healthcare program
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about the military families who say they are receiving bills they shouldn’t - in some cases - even as they are battling terminal illness.

headlines.title: A rising political star in China is the latest victim of Xi’s purge
headlines.description: He was on the rise among China’s political elite, hosting tech leaders and senior American officials.

headlines.title: Black Friday deals are here, and they’re actually really good — I’m tracking the best ones live
headlines.description: Black Friday officially starts in 48 hours, but deals are already live. Our shopping experts are live tracking what’s worth it at Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target and more.

headlines.title: How are you affording the holidays?
headlines.description: After a year of high gas prices, inflation ticking back up and a lot of Americans feeling pessimistic about the economy, we want to know how people are affording the annual wave of holiday gifts, travel and entertainment costs.

headlines.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
headlines.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Questions linger about lead pollution from Iowa blast, despite officials’ assurances
headlines.description: Scientists and Iowa residents said questions remain about how much contamination the Army’s detonation of lead azide caused, though they were hopeful about the initial results.
